title: Sample run walkthrough
note: Screenshots from a real local controller run on 2026-10-26 (Asia/Calcutta). Not a research result.

steps.title: Idle Demo page
steps.caption: The Demo page loads on GitHub Pages with the saved report. The Run button stays off until a local controller is paired.

steps.title: Paired with local controller
steps.caption: Connect the loopback controller and enter the one-time pairing code. Only then can Run demo fire.

steps.title: Run demo clicked
steps.caption: One click starts the real interview harness: deterministic scan, then gemma3 → qwen3 → llama3.2 against each target.

steps.title: In progress — model scanning
steps.caption: Real progress stream while gemma3:1b / qwen3:1.7b / llama3.2:3b analyze each target.

steps.title: Per-target results table
steps.caption: Ground-truth table: planted avatar_store verified; clean targets never escalate false alarms to VERIFIED.

steps.title: Verified planted finding
steps.caption: Path-traversal evidence: probe leaked the planted secret. That is why the finding is VERIFIED, not just claimed.

steps.title: Rejected false alarms
steps.caption: False positives on clean targets: models claimed vulns, probes failed, status stays UNVERIFIED.

steps.title: Why llama missed
steps.caption: llama3.2:3b returned CLEAN_CLAIM on the planted target. The demo keeps that miss — nothing is rewritten.
